name: concord-multi-agent-taskboard
description: A persistent Kanban task board and a documented Concord MCP collaboration experiment.

scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @taskboard/shared && npm run dev -w @taskboard/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @taskboard/shared && npm run build -w @taskboard/api && npm run build -w @taskboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @taskboard/shared && npm run typecheck -w @taskboard/shared && npm run typecheck -w @taskboard/api && npm run typecheck -w @taskboard/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @taskboard/shared && npm run test -w @taskboard/shared && npm run test -w @taskboard/api && npm run test -w @taskboard/web
